title: Baleadas
description: Baleadas is a dish from Honduras featuring all-purpose flour, kidney beans, queso fresco, sour cream. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Refried red beans are made at home from cooked kidney beans; authentic baleada beans are often blended more finely.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 18 minutes.
Soak the dried beans in ample clean cold water for about 480 minutes, drain and discard the soaking water; cook fully in fresh water.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 75 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Mash the fully cooked beans with a little of their cooking liquid into a thick spread, then spoon onto the warm tortillas.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 14 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
